test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The old man started to __blow his own trumpet__ at the meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Talk boastfully about oneself'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom is: **'Talk boastfully about oneself'.**
 
• The idiom **'blow his own trumpet'** means talk boastfully about one's achievements.
 
 
• **Example:** *He refused to **blow his own trumpet** and blushingly declined to speak.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Be friendly'** means kind and pleasant.
 
• **'Support one’s cause'** means to ask others to join a cause or to help promote a cause.
 
• **'Make fun of'** means tease, laugh at, or joke about someone in a mocking way.
